title: India flags high unpaid UN dues, raises concern over 2026 liquidity crunch
description:
India has voiced concern over the "challenging" liquidity situation of the United Nations this year, as it called out the "unacceptably high levels" of unpaid assessments owed by just one member state.
"We consider that full, timely and unconditional payment of assessed contribution is the Charter obligation of every Member State," Counsellor in the Permanent Mission of India to the UN Surendra Adhana said here Monday.
Adhana delivered India's national statement at the 81st Main Session of the Fifth Committee of the UN General Assembly on 'Improving the financial situation of the United Nations'.
"We note with concern that the liquidity situation in 2026 remained challenging due to the collection uncertainties and low cash balance," he said.
